bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
printf 'TARGET_REPO='; git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#https://[^/@]+@#https://#'
printf 'HOST_CHECKOUT_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
if git fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111 2>/dev/null; then echo FETCH=PASS; else echo FETCH=FAIL; exit 74; fi
if git cat-file -e 450a4d69691a11529f0e3850b8575bf513247ddc^{commit}; then echo TARGET_COMMIT=PASS; else echo TARGET_COMMIT=FAIL; exit 75; fi
if git show 450a4d69691a11529f0e3850b8575bf513247ddc:artifacts/bot/src/services/postingDomain.ts | grep -Fq 'https://meet.ffmuc.net'; then echo JITSI_ORIGIN=PASS; else echo JITSI_ORIGIN=FAIL; exit 76; fi
echo JITSI_SOURCE_DIAGNOSTIC=PASS
